items.title: Meta Ads: $341.23 spend, 23 leads, $14.84 CPL (7-day window) — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The last successful meta-ads run was 2026-09-08 (covering through 2026-09-07), so this run widened to the 7-day cap (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27) to close as much of the gap as allowed. Over that window Meta spent $341.23, entirely on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 23 leads at $14.84 CPL — close to its prior 7-day baseline (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20: $352.41 / 26 leads, ~$13.55 CPL), so no anomaly. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Gap wider than the 7-day cap: the last successful meta-ads.json run was 2026-09-08 (window ended 2026-09-07). This run widened to the maximum 7 days (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27), but 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-20 (13 days) has no Meta ads data ingested at all and cannot be recovered by this agent — needs either a manual backfill run with explicit --since/--until or acceptance of the gap.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 23, matching the counted leads exactly, same pattern flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, 2026-09-07, and 2026-09-08). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this has now recurred across every run on record — the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
